charts.source: AstroSpace generated baseline; replace with externally verified chart before treating as authoritative.

AstroSage Celebrity Kundli, https://celebrity.astrosage.com/amitabh-bachchan-birth-chart.asp (accessed 2026-07-14). Page states: born Oct 11, 1942, 16:00:00, Allahabad (81E50, 25N57, TZ 5.5); Ascendant Aquarius; Moon in Libra, Swati nakshatra pada 2; Sun Virgo; Mars Virgo; Mercury Virgo (retrograde, exalted); Jupiter Cancer (exalted); Venus Virgo (debilitated); Saturn Taurus (retrograde); Balance of Dasha RAHU 12Y 3M 8D. Source rating on page: 'Accurate (A)' from Kundli Sangraha (Bhat). AstroSage charts use Lahiri ayanamsha.
charts.notes: Known deviation, deliberately NOT asserted: AstroSage computes with a fixed UTC+5:30, but the IANA tzdb (which this engine uses) applies Indian WWII war time (UTC+6:30) on 1942-10-11, shifting the birth instant by 1h of UT. All sign/nakshatra/pada-level values above still agree, but the Vimshottari balance differs (AstroSage Rahu 12y3m8d vs engine ~13.07y), so the dasha balance is only asserted at lord level. Vara (Sunday) is a civil-calendar fact for 1942-10-11, not stated on the source page.
